pulse.currentFocus: S294 root-caused and fixed a founder-reported P0: the playable Franchise Architect page served as unstyled text because all three of its documents declared a <base href> pointing at the About directory, which ships no app assets. Introduced by the S284 slug rebrand and broken since. Fixed, browser-verified, and gated by check-base-href-resolution so the class cannot return. The fix is in main but cannot reach production while the fail-closed promotion interlock holds on five credential-gated identity reasons.
pulse.nextMilestone: Restore Supabase SQL/Function authority and complete the real-provider identity ceremony, then rerun the release gate and restore/promote the production Worker only on all-green evidence — and verify the incident-close path against that real recovery.
blockers: The Supabase authority receipt is 1/4 ready: REST is HTTP 200, while management API, SQL migration, and Edge Function authority need an approved token or database/function credential through the secrets gateway.

The archive migration and Eternal Intelligence update are not deployed; authenticated Archive/Eternal tests and a real-provider Obelisk callback/session/member/investor/revocation journey must pass before production promotion.

Production CONTENT deploys are not landing (found S293, separate from the Worker hold): live /api/build-sha.json serves 4a72961d from 2026-07-24, 134 commits and 2.3 days behind origin/main, while Cloudflare Pages Deploy and Cache Purge report success on every push. npm run verify:deploy-parity is red on four missing live shell assets. Now measured every 30 minutes by api/deploy-currency.json; the deploy path itself is diagnosed but unrepaired.

Production Worker /v/rum has been stale since the 2026-07-03 out-of-band clobber, so RUM telemetry ingest is dark (last data 2026-07-02). As of S293 the degradation is measured, not just asserted: all 5 expected route contracts have been unmatched for at least 13.3 days (onset no later than 2026-07-12T23:52:39Z, corroborated by data/uptime-history.ndjson), and it is published on /status/. The canonical redeploy (gh workflow run cloudflare-worker-deploy.yml -f confirm_production=true) is founder-gated behind the fail-closed production promotion hold — restore requires clearing or explicitly accepting that hold.

now: [S294→FOUNDER][DEPLOY/P0] The Franchise Architect fix cannot reach production while the promotion hold stands. Production is 143 commits / 2.3 days stale. Gate holds on `supabase-migration-pending`, `eternal-function-pending`, `real-provider-e2e-pending`, `supabase-control-plane-partial`, `independent-release-gate-no-go` — all credential-gated. Release: `gh workflow run pages-deploy.yml -f confirm_production=true`. Founder decision (production promotion under an explicit hold, CANON-019) — not dispatched autonomously.

[S294][OPS/P0] BUILT — content-hotfix promotion lane. Founder chose it over releasing the hold. `pages-deploy.yml` gained a second independent gate (`check-content-hotfix-gate.mjs`, self-test 25/25) that rebuilds the tree already in production and overlays only an explicitly listed, allowlisted content set. Measured first: the naive "promote everything if the diff is content-only" design was rejected as dead code — the diff since the deployed SHA is 444 files and genuinely touches `_headers`, `auth/`, `sw.js`, `login.html`, `cloudflare/`, `supabase/`. Verified locally against the real baseline: exactly 3 files differ, sensitive files byte-identical, the identity interlock untouched and still `hold`. Deny-by-default allowlist; baseline SHA stamped so deploy-currency cannot claim production is current (D-S294.8, D-S294.9).

[S294][PRODUCT/P1] RESOLVED — Play-CTA destination decided by the founder this session: Play → the game's `liveUrl`; every other link → the fully built-out landing page, as with all other games. Implemented and gated (D-S294.5, D-S294.6). Original question retained below for provenance.

Repoint the CTAs to that domain (retiring/redirecting the on-site copy), or keep the on-site playable build canonical? Public routing change — awaiting founder answer.
next: [S260][SIL][PROCESS/P2] Generalize active-sink guards from specific TT rows to freshness-ranked input — DONE S261. Analyzer emits `.cache/tt-active-local-sinks.json`; guard consumes it and proves active-local unresolved rows are 0.
shipped: Root cause: `franchise-architect/{index,game,404}.html` declared `<base href="/games/franchise-architect/" />`. That directory is the About page and ships no app assets, while `styles.css`/`setup.js`/`app.js` live in `/franchise-architect/`. Every relative asset resolved to the 404 HTML page, which the browser refused by MIME type. Introduced by the S284 slug rebrand (`1bf88182e`) and broken since.

The site's links were already correct — `/games/franchise-architect/` is About, `/franchise-architect/` is Play. Only the `<base>` was wrong. These were the only three `<base>` tags on the entire site.
Fixed + verified in a real browser at both `/franchise-architect/` and `/franchise-architect/game.html`: own stylesheet applied, 0 failed requests, 0 console errors, League Hub renders fully styled.
Gated: `check-base-href-resolution.mjs` (self-test 14/14) resolves each relative ref through its `<base>` and asserts the target exists. Confirmed red on the real regression, green on the fix.

S293 correction: the stale production deploy is the fail-closed promotion interlock working as designed, not a broken deploy path (D-S294.2). The S293 false-green finding on the startup brief remains entirely valid.
